tool_result_transport.content: one concise text summary for the calling Agent
tool_result_transport.structuredContent: one acs-mcp-result/2 success or problem envelope
tool_result_transport.isError: false for accepted observations and state transitions; true for rejected or failed tool execution

collaboration_plan_apply.title: Apply collaboration plan
collaboration_plan_apply.description: Atomically create or revise an explicit collaboration plan containing Scope, AgentSlot, role, Grant, Policy and budget bindings. Returns the accepted collaboration handle and revision.
collaboration_plan_apply.selection_guidance: Use when an Agent has already decided the collaboration topology and needs ACS to authorize and persist it.

harness_capacity_list.title: List eligible Harness capacity
harness_capacity_list.description: List current Harness capacities eligible for a Scope, role and capability set. Returns bounded Machine, Node, Driver, Harness, direction, readiness, evidence and expiry metadata.
harness_capacity_list.selection_guidance: Use before assigning work to discover capacities supported by current observations.

message_send.title: Send collaboration message
message_send.description: Commit one collaboration Message, its delivery intent, response expectation and completion notification. Returns delivery state, the stable response handle and executable follow-up calls. Async is the default; sync adds one bounded observation of the same response handle.
message_send.selection_guidance: Use for delegation, review requests, handoffs and other addressed collaboration work.

response_await.title: Await collaboration response
response_await.description: Observe one or more existing response handles until any or all reach a named receipt or terminal condition, bounded by the supplied timeout. Returns satisfied, pending and terminal handles while durable tracking and completion notification continue.
response_await.selection_guidance: Use when the calling Agent chooses to pause for responses that message_send is already tracking.

resource_read.title: Read collaboration resource
resource_read.description: Read one authorized typed handle for a collaboration plan, Message, response, WorkItem, Evidence or Artifact. Returns bounded metadata, relations, content or content reference, evidence handles and continuation state.
resource_read.selection_guidance: Use the exact handle and view returned by another ACS tool or Inbox item.

inbox_list.title: List AgentSlot Inbox
inbox_list.description: List durable Messages and completion notifications addressed to the authenticated AgentSlot. Returns stable handles, delivery state, completion revision and executable resource_read calls.
inbox_list.selection_guidance: Use at startup, reconnect or recovery to resume collaboration from the durable AgentSlot Inbox.

response_notification_set.title: Set response notification
response_notification_set.description: Enable or disable automatic completion notification for an existing response handle using an expected subscription revision. Returns the updated subscription state while preserving response tracking.
response_notification_set.selection_guidance: Use only to change the automatic notification created by message_send.

work_item_cancel.title: Cancel WorkItem
work_item_cancel.description: Request cancellation of one WorkItem at its expected revision and record the authorized reason. Returns WorkItem state and any Runtime Attempts that still require observation or separate cancellation.
work_item_cancel.selection_guidance: Use to end the durable collaboration work objective represented by a WorkItem.

runtime_attempt_cancel.title: Cancel Runtime Attempt
runtime_attempt_cancel.description: Request cancellation of one concrete Runtime Attempt at its expected revision and report the Driver acknowledgement boundary. Returns Attempt state and effect uncertainty requiring readback.
runtime_attempt_cancel.selection_guidance: Use for a specific execution attempt after its owning WorkItem policy authorizes attempt-level control.

domain_command_submit.title: Submit Domain command
domain_command_submit.description: Submit one fully formed authenticated Domain SurfaceCommand. Returns the canonical Domain disposition and references used by operator, migration, conformance and advanced automation flows.
domain_command_submit.selection_guidance: Use when the caller owns the complete versioned Domain command contract; ordinary Agent collaboration uses the typed tools.
